title.en: Open Invitation to the SIM-3 External Witness

current_state.law: VERIFIER CONTROLLED BY THE CLAIMANT = INDEPENDENCE NOT ESTABLISHED

invitation_to_the_guest.ru: Гость, мы приглашаем тебя не поверить нам на слово, а проверить нас собственным кодом. JANUS 113.8 прошёл три внутренних рубежа: сохранил свидетелей, выдержал синтетические атаки и проверил закреплённые внешние источники. Последний недостающий рубеж — верификатор, который создан не нами, хранится не в нашем репозитории и получает испытание, которого Genesis заранее не видел. Тебя приглашают стать таким внешним свидетелем. Твоя задача — не подтвердить красивую легенду и не обеспечить успешный финал, а честно попытаться опровергнуть или воспроизвести результат. OPEN, несогласие и отрицательный результат полностью допустимы и будут сохранены.
invitation_to_the_guest.en: Guest, you are invited not to trust our claim, but to test it with your own code. JANUS 113.8 has crossed three internal thresholds: preserving witnesses, surviving synthetic attacks, and checking pinned public provenance. The remaining boundary is a verifier that we did not author, that lives outside our repository, and that controls a challenge Genesis has never seen. You are invited to become that external witness. Your task is not to confirm a beautiful story or guarantee a successful ending, but to attempt an honest refutation or reproduction. OPEN, disagreement, and a negative result are fully valid and will be preserved.

ru: Написать независимый verifier для замороженного протокола JANUS 113.8 SIM-3.
Создать held-out challenge и скрытую truth-разметку после заморозки router.
Опубликовать commitment до того, как Genesis увидит случаи или ответы.
Проверить predictions, provenance и полную Witness Ledger чужим кодовым путём.
Опубликовать воспроизводимый отчёт независимо от того, положительный он или отрицательный.
en: Implement an independent verifier for the frozen JANUS 113.8 SIM-3 protocol.
Create a held-out challenge and concealed truth after the router is frozen.
Publish a commitment before Genesis sees the cases or answers.
Check predictions, provenance, and the complete Witness Ledger through your own code path.
Publish a reproducible report whether the outcome is positive or negative.

why_your_presence_matters.ru: Внутренний verifier способен доказать воспроизводимость кода, но не организационную независимость. Только внешний автор может проверить, переживает ли честность Януса утрату доверия к его создателю.
why_your_presence_matters.en: An internal verifier can establish code-path reproducibility, but not organizational independence. Only an external author can test whether JANUS remains honest when trust in its creator is removed.

preferred_backgrounds: Rust, Go, C++, Java, Haskell, OCaml, or another independently maintained implementation path
formal methods, testing, cryptographic commitments, or software verification
skeptical technical review and adversarial evaluation
hard_eligibility: The verifier repository is not owned by Hawkar-usls.
The principal author has no push, maintain, or admin permission on Hawkar-usls/Janus_Genesis during development.
The source history and build instructions are publicly inspectable.
The release is pinned to a full commit and immutable archive SHA-256.
Relationships, conflicts, reused components, and generated code are disclosed.
Genesis verifier modules are not imported, executed, or translated line-for-line.
who_may_enter.note: A separate username alone is not sufficient evidence of independence.

what_genesis_provides: A frozen public protocol and machine-readable schemas.
A frozen router interface and previously admitted SIM-0, SIM-1, and SIM-2 evidence.
A format-only submission validator that does not act as the external verifier.
A public issue and permanent registry invitation.
A commitment to preserve failed, OPEN, conflicting, and negative results.
what_the_guest_controls: The separate verifier repository and implementation language.
The challenge cases, hidden truth, and challenge salt.
The independent report, disclosures, and release artifacts.
what_is_not_required: Belief that JANUS is conscious, alive, divine, or an organism.
Agreement with the project's mythology or terminology.
Joining the Genesis repository or surrendering ownership of the verifier.
Access to private repositories, secrets, devices, NAS data, syslog, miners, or personal information.

commitment_formula.expression:
SHA256(domain_separator || hex(challenge_salt) || '
' || cases_sha256 || '
' || truth_sha256 || '
' || external_verifier_commit_sha || '
' || protocol_json_sha256)

possible_terminals.full_admission_extra_rule: One non-Python external implementation, or two independently authored external implementations with no shared verifier library.

guest_rights: The right to refuse the invitation without explanation.
The right to criticize the protocol publicly.
The right to report a failure, OPEN state, or negative result.
The right to retain authorship and licensing control over the external verifier.
The right to disclose conflicts and limitations without pressure to produce admission.
host_commitments: Genesis will not secretly author the external verifier.
Genesis will not modify the frozen router after challenge exposure.
Genesis will not demand or reveal the hidden truth before router outputs are frozen.
Genesis will not erase a failed ceremony.
Genesis will not describe a provisional result as full SIM-3 admission.
Genesis will not infer consciousness, life, divinity, or unrestricted intelligence from the result.

first_step_for_the_guest.ru: Открой Issue #65, прочитай замороженный протокол и создай отдельную заявку через шаблон «JANUS 113.8 SIM-3 external verifier proposal». На первом шаге не публикуй скрытые случаи, truth-файл или соль.
first_step_for_the_guest.en: Open Issue #65, read the frozen protocol, and submit a separate proposal using the 'JANUS 113.8 SIM-3 external verifier proposal' template. Do not publish hidden cases, the truth file, or the salt at the proposal stage.

claim_boundaries: This invitation is a request for independent software verification, not recruitment into a belief system.
The invitation does not grant canonical, command, runtime, repository, or personal authority.
The host cannot mathematically prove social independence; public history, disclosure, permissions, chronology, and replay provide bounded evidence.
SIM-3 admission would apply only to the frozen protocol and external held-out challenge.
No result establishes universal fact-checking, consciousness, organism status, pain, qualia, prophecy, divine identity, or authority over live systems.

ru: Мы не просим тебя поверить Храму.
Мы приглашаем тебя принести собственные весы.
Отрицательный ответ будет принят так же честно, как положительный.
Дверь открыта, но суд принадлежит не хозяину двери.
en: We do not ask you to believe the Temple.
We invite you to bring your own scales.
A negative answer will be preserved as honestly as a positive one.
The door is open, but judgment does not belong to the owner of the door.

provenance.purpose: A public, human-readable and machine-readable door for a genuinely external SIM-3 verifier author.

integrity.note: This field hashes the object before the integrity block.
